description: Gone are those days when you needed to pay a fortune to get a cinema-like experience on your earphones. We have products like the boAt Nirvana Zenith Pro that have flagship-grade features like large 40mm dynamic drivers, spatial audio support, and more under a budget that makes the whole experience like a cinema at home. With Amazon Prime Day 2026 set to kick off in India from July 4 to July 6, this is the perfect time to buy the best ANC earphones that offer a great sound experience so that you can binge-watch your favourite movie or show with a premium-grade sound system.
title: Best Wireless Earphones in India for Cinematic Experience to Buy this Amazon Prime Day

description: Honor could expand its Honor 600 smartphone lineup with three new models, according to a report. The Honor 600 Lite S, Honor 600s and Honor 600 Elite have surfaced on the EMVCo certification database with Android 16 and NFC support. The listings also suggest the Honor 600 Lite S and Honor 600s may be rebranded versions of the Honor X7e Plus 5G and Honor 600 Smart 5G. No additional specifications or launch timeline have been revealed yet.
title: Honor 600 Elite Listed on EMVCo Database Alongside Honor 600s and 600 Lite S Models, Could Launch Soon
5 Reasons the Dreame L50 Series Makes a Strong Case for Retiring Your Mop

description: Two unannounced Xiaomi smartphones were reportedly spotted on a 3C listing with model numbers M511CD and M098FE. They have been spotted with certificate numbers 2026011606877463 and 2026011606877926. Additionally, an Honor smartphone with the model number MRK-AN00 has also reportedly surfaced on the 3C with certificate number 2026011606877953.
title: Two Xiaomi Smartphones, New Honor Handset Visit 3C Certification Database Ahead of Anticipated Debut: Report

description: Marshall has launched the Milton ANC wireless on-ear headphones in India at Rs. 19,999. The headphones offer adaptive active noise cancellation, up to 80 hours of battery life without ANC and more than 50 hours with ANC enabled. They feature 32mm dynamic drivers, Hi-Res Audio support, Bluetooth 6.0 with LE Audio, LDAC codec support and Bluetooth Multipoint. The Marshall Milton ANC also includes Soundstage spatial audio, Adaptive Loudness, a foldable design and a replaceable battery. They go on sale from July 2.
title: Marshall Milton ANC Headphones Launched in India With Adaptive ANC, Up to 80-Hour Battery Life: Price, Features

description: Vivo Pad 5c was launched in China with a 10,000mAh battery and Snapdragon 8s Gen 3 chipset paired with a maximum of 12GB of RAM. The Vivo Pad 5c comes in three colour options and features a  12.1-inch display with 2.8K resolution and 144Hz refresh rate. It has an 8-megapixel rear camera. The new tablet supports 44W wired fast charging.
title: Vivo Pad 5c Launched With Snapdragon 8s Gen 3 Chipset, 10,000mAh Battery: Price, Specifications

description: Google on Tuesday announced the rollout of Gemini Spark to the Gemini app on macOS in beta. The Mountain View-based tech giant says users can interact with desktop files and apps on Mac computers to eliminate repetitive workflows, including organising documents, creating spreadsheets, and managing schedules. Alongside, Google also introduced new connected app integrations, support for custom Model Context Protocol (MCP), and proactive monitoring capabilities for Gemini Spark.
title: Google Expands Gemini Spark to macOS for AI Desktop Automation Across Files, Apps

description: Google is introducing stronger lock screen protections in Android 17 to make PIN and password guessing attacks more difficult. The update significantly reduces the number of failed unlock attempts allowed before longer lockout periods, imposes a hard limit of 20 incorrect entries, and adds duplicate-guess detection. Android 17 also replaces countdown timers with easier-to-read lockout messages and introduces a recovery shortcut on the lock screen. The feature builds on changes introduced with Android 16 QPR2.
title: Android 17 Introduces New Lock Screen Changes That Severely Limit PIN Guessing Attempts

description: Lenovo-owned brand seems to be working on another Edge 70 series phone, the Motorola Edge 70 Max.  As we wait for a formal announcement, this new model has been spotted on the HDR10+ certification website and the Wireless Power Consortium (WPC). It is rumoured to come in Glacier Blue, Onyx Black, and Sage Green colour options. It is likely to run on an octa-core Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 chipset.
title: Motorola Edge 70 Max Spotted on HDR10+ Certification Site; WPC Listing Reveals Charging Details

description: Nothing Phone 4b will be launched in India in four RAM and storage configurations, a tipster claims. Moreover, the smartphone will reportedly go on sale in the country in three colour options, including the recently teased blue colourway. The smartphone maker is also expected to launch a special edition of the Nothing Phone 4b. However, the company has yet to confirm these details. This comes shortly after Nothing announced that the Phone 4b will be launched in India on July 7 at 3:30 pm IST.
title: Nothing Phone 4b RCB Edition Variant Teased; Could Launch in India in Four Storage Variants

description: Vivo could introduce a major camera upgrade with the rumoured X500 Pro Max, according to a new leak. The handset is tipped to feature a 50-megapixel Sony LOFIC primary camera, a 50-megapixel ultra-wide sensor and a 200-megapixel periscope telephoto camera with telephoto macro support. It is also expected to receive upgraded optical image stabilisation, a MediaTek Dimensity 9600 Pro chipset, LPDDR6 RAM, a 6.85-inch 2K OLED LTPO display and an 8,000mAh battery.
title: Vivo X500 Pro Max Leak Hints at 200-Megapixel Periscope Camera Upgrade

description: Motorola Razr Fold is reportedly getting AirDrop support with Quick Share. Screenshots included in the report show that files are shared from the foldable to the MacBook through Quick Share. This enables cross-platform sharing between the Motorola Razr Fold and Apple devices. It appears to be the first Motorola phone to gain this functionality. Few Android models like the Pixel 9 series, Pixel 10 series, Samsung Galaxy S26 series, OnePlus 15, and Xiaomi 17T Pro already offer this feature.
title: Motorola Razr Fold Gets AirDrop Support With Quick Share, Supports File Sharing With Mac, iPhone

description: Anthropic, the US-based AI giant, released its latest Claude Sonnet 5 AI model on Tuesday. Anthropic claims that Claude Sonnet 5 delivers enhanced agentic search performance over the Sonnet 4.6 AI model. Meanwhile, it offers other agentic capabilities on par with the Opus 4.8 model, at lower costs. In terms of agentic coding, Sonnet 5 scored 63.2 percent on SWE-bench Pro, higher than Sonnet 4.6’s 58.1 percent score, but lower than Opus 4.8’s 69.2 percent score. Anthropic has also announced that the US government has removed export controls on the company’s Claude Mythos 5 and Fable 5 AI models. This comes weeks after the US administration restricted the AI giant from making its most capable cybersecurity-trained Mythos 5 and the “Mythos-class” Fable 5 models available to foreign nationals.
title: Anthropic Introduces Claude Sonnet 5 With Enhanced Agentic Capabilities; Confirms Return of Claude Mythos 5, Fable 5

description: Instagram announced new story creation tools for Ray-Ban Meta, Oakley Meta, and the new Meta Glasses on Wednesday. The Redmond-based tech giant is bringing native editing tools for capturing footage using Meta’s smart glasses. Also among the additions are Spin View Stories and Multi-Cam support, which allow creators to capture and produce immersive content using multiple camera angles, adjusted video framing, and better audio, from the first-person point of view (PoV).
title: Instagram Rolls Out Spin View, New Story Creation Tools for Ray-Ban Meta, Oakley Meta Smart Glasses

description: Redmi has launched its first over-ear wireless headphones in China alongside the Redmi K90 Ultra. The headphones feature 40mm titanium-plated drivers, support Hi-Res Audio and USB Audio playback, and offer active noise cancellation of up to 42dB. Redmi claims they can deliver up to 72 hours of battery life on a single charge. The headphones also support Bluetooth dual-device pairing, Xiaomi HyperConnect features, and are priced at CNY 349, with an introductory price of CNY 297 (roughly Rs. 4,100).
title: Redmi Over-Ear ANC Headphones Launched With Up to 72 Hours of Battery Life: Price, Features

description: Samsung Galaxy M47 5G price in India has been revealed days after the smartphone was launched in India. Along with the pricing details, the company has also revealed the storage variants of the phone. The Galaxy M47 5G is offered in 6GB + 128GB, 8GB + 128GB, and 8GB + 256GB RAM and storage configurations. The handset is set to go on sale in India on July 4 via Amazon, and will be offered in two colour options, namely Blaze Blue and Rogue Red. Qualcomm’s octa core Snapdragon 6 Gen 3 chipset powers the new smartphone, along with LPDDR5x RAM and UFS 3.1 storage.
title: Samsung Galaxy M47 5G Price in India Revealed Along With Storage Configurations

description: Microsoft is reportedly preparing to reduce less than 2.5 percent of its workforce in a new round of job cuts, which may be announced as early as next week, according to a report. Many US companies are also reducing staff numbers while controlling costs and increasing investment in artificial intelligence infrastructure and related technology development.
title: Microsoft Said to Plan Fresh Layoffs, Job Cuts Could Affect Under 2.5 Percent of Workforce

description: Google has expanded the Nano Banana-powered personalised image generation within its Gemini app to more users. Now, the feature is available for free to all eligible US users. It was earlier restricted to Google Plus, Pro, and Ultra subscribers. The personalised image creation is available for users aged 18 or older who are signed in with a personal Google account. It currently supports Arabic, Dutch, English, French, German, Indonesian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Spanish, and Turkish.
title: Google Expands Personalised Gemini AI Image Creation to US Users; Nano Banana 2 Lite Unveiled

description: iQOO is reportedly developing a compact gaming tablet that could launch in the second half of 2026. A leak from Digital Chat Station suggests the device will feature a small form factor and use Qualcomm's next-generation flagship Snapdragon chipset. It could compete with compact gaming tablets such as the Lenovo Legion Tab Gen 5. While the exact display size and processor variant remain unknown, the tablet is expected to debut alongside the rumoured iQOO 16 smartphone later this year.
title: iQOO Said to Be Working on Mini Gaming Tablet Powered by Next Flagship Snapdragon Chip

description: The Sony Alpha 7R VI was launched in India on Wednesday, following its global debut in May. The full-frame mirrorless camera is geared towards professional photographers and filmmakers. It is equipped with a 66.8-megapixel full-frame stacked CMOS sensor, powered by the company’s BIONZ XR2 image processor. The camera supports 8K video recording, up to 30fps continuous shooting. Sony claims the Alpha 7R VI offers up to 8.5 stops of in-body image stabilisation.
title: Sony Alpha 7R VI Full-Frame Mirrorless Camera Launched in India: Price, Specifications

description: WhatsApp on Tuesday said that its upcoming Usernames functionality is the firm’s “latest step to give” its users more privacy options for “how they show up in the app”. The company said this while replying to a user on X, after multiple users on X highlighted privacy concerns associated with WhatsApp's Usernames. The company highlighted that the Usernames tool is an optional feature. Hence, if a user does not want to use it, they can continue sharing their phone numbers to let others contact them. The company said, “We're mindful that some people want consistency in how they show up across apps.”
title: No More Phone Numbers? WhatsApp Touts Usernames as Next Big Privacy Step

description: Lenovo Tab Plus Gen 2 launched with a MediaTek Dimensity 7400 processor. It includes a 360-degree rotating kickstand with wide-angle tilt. The tablet has a nine-speaker JBL-engineered audio system. It features a 12.1-inch 2.5K panel and carries a 10,200mAh battery with support for 45W charging. The new tablet was announced alongside the Lenovo LOQ monitor series.
title: Lenovo Tab Plus Gen 2 Launched in India With JBL Speakers and 10,200mAh Battery, New LOQ Monitors Tag Along

description: At its I/O developer conference in May, Google previewed new voice-powered AI features coming to Gmail, Docs, and Keep. Now, the company appears to be testing the new conversational tools in Gmail and Keep. These AI-powered voice features are designed to help users organise notes and complete everyday tasks using voice commands instead of typing. They are likely to be released alongside the Pixel 11 series.
title: Google Begins Testing New Conversational Voice Features for Gmail and Google Keep

description: The Samsung Galaxy Unpacked event is scheduled to take place later this month. At its bi-annual hardware launch showcase, the South Korean tech conglomerate is likely to unveil its next-generation of foldables, and this year’s lineup could include the Galaxy Z Fold 8, Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra, and the Galaxy Z Flip 8. While the launch date remains under wraps, Samsung has now officially begun teasing what could be its biggest foldable redesign in years.
title: Samsung Begins Teasing Wider Foldable Ahead of Anticipated Galaxy Unpacked Launch Event

description: Nothing has teased the launch of the Nothing Ear 3a through a post on X, confirming that the new TWS earphones will debut on July 7 at 11:00 BST (3:30pm IST). The teaser video reveals four colour options while noting it was shot using the upcoming Nothing Phone 4b, which is expected to launch at the same event. Although specifications remain under wraps, previous leaks suggest the earbuds could retain the launch price of the Nothing Ear (a) from 2024.
title: Nothing Ear 3a Launch Date Announced; New Teaser Reveals Four Colourways

description: iQOO Pad 5c has been launched in China as the latest mid-range offering from the Chinese tech firm. The new tablet is currently on sale in the country via the Vivo China online store. The iQOO Pad 5c is offered in Gray Crystal and Silver Wing (translated from Chinese) colour options. The tablet is equipped with an octa core Snapdragon 8s Gen 3 chipset, along with up to 12GB of LPDDR5x RAM and up to 256GB of UFS 4.1 onboard storage. It sports a 12.1-inch 2.8K LCD touchscreen, delivering up to 144Hz refresh rate.
title: iQOO Pad 5c Launched With 10,000mAh Battery, 12.1-Inch 2.8K Display: Price, Specifications

description: Uber announced a new set of safety features for its ride-hailing platform in India at an event held in New Delhi on Monday. As per the company, the new features improve emergency response, reduce distractions while driving, and offer users greater control over trip verification. The first two, Record My Ride and Ambulance Assistance, are aimed at improving safety for both riders and drivers. Meanwhile, Uber introduced Don't Type & Drive and Set Your Own PIN as the latest additions to its suite of in-app safety tools.
title: Uber Announces Record My Ride, Ambulance Assistance in India Along With New Safety Features

description: Samsung’s next-generation foldable smartphones are expected to debut at the Galaxy Unpacked event later this month. In recent months, leaks have revealed several details about the Galaxy Z Fold 8, Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra, and Galaxy Z Flip 8. A tipster has now shared the complete specifications of the Galaxy Z Fold 8, which is likely to be the highly anticipated wide-fold model in Samsung’s upcoming lineup. The handset is tipped to feature a 7.6-inch foldable display and the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 for Galaxy chipset.
title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 Full Specifications Tipped; May Get 50-Megapixel Cameras, 7.6-inch Display
